newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Malbak sells ICL Technology stake.
newsitem.headline: Malbak sells ICL Technology stake.

text.p: South Africa's Malbak Ltd said on Tuesday that it had sold its stake in ICL Technology Holdings Ltd to ICL Retail Systems GMBh, a unit of Britain's ICL UK, for an undisclosed sum.
Malbak is nearing the end of a lengthy process of unbundling its wide selection of shareholdings in a move that will see it become a packaging firm.
In a brief statement the firm said it would make a further announcement about shares it still holds in Haggie Ltd in due course.
Last week Malbak also renewed a cautionary announcement, saying that talks were ongoing which may have an effect on its share price.
"Malbak is not likely to be in a position to make a further statement in this regard for some weeks," the firm said.
South African financial markets have been abuzz in recent weeks on speculation that industrial conglomerate Rembrandt Group Ltd (Remgro) is set to buy Malbak through its Lenco Holdings Ltd unit.
Lenco last month issued a cautionary announcement, saying it was in unspecified talks.
